rules.description: Applicant must be a UK resident (not Northern Ireland)
rules.reason_if_failed: Council Tax Reduction is not available in Northern Ireland. There's a different scheme called Rate Relief.

rules.description: Applicant must be liable for Council Tax in the local authority area
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be liable for Council Tax in this council area to apply for reduction

rules.description: Applicant must be on low income or claim qualifying benefits
rules.reason_if_failed: Council Tax Reduction is for people on low income or claiming benefits. Your income may be too high.

rules.description: Total household savings must be below the council's threshold (typically £16,000)
rules.reason_if_failed: Your household savings exceed the threshold for Council Tax Reduction in this council area

rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old (or emancipated minor)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be 18 or over to apply for Council Tax Reduction

explanation_template: Council Tax Reduction eligibility: {outcome}. Your council will assess your household income, savings, and circumstances to determine the reduction amount.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has reached State Pension age
edge_cases.action: Route to pension-age Council Tax Reduction scheme. Different rules and thresholds apply.

edge_cases.description: Applicant or household members are full-time students
edge_cases.action: Full-time students usually exempt from Council Tax entirely. Check if Council Tax exemption applies before reduction.

edge_cases.description: Household includes non-dependant adults or multiple families
edge_cases.action: Manual assessment required. Non-dependant deductions will apply to reduction calculation.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is refugee or asylum seeker with uncertain immigration status
edge_cases.action: Special rules apply. Route to specialist caseworker. Asylum seekers may be exempt from Council Tax.

edge_cases.description: Applicant or household member has severe disability
edge_cases.action: Enhanced reduction may apply. Ensure Severe Disability Premium is included in assessment.
Assessment based on Universal Credit award. Income fluctuations may affect monthly reduction.
